---
title: ECR Events
---

Early-career researchers (ECRs) are a key component of the European complement network, and we are keen to welcome you all to capital of Wales for EMCHD26. 
Organised in collaboration between the local organising committee and Early-Career Complementologists (ECCO) we have a selection of great activities to help foster relationships between ECRs and make sure ECRs are at the forefront of the meeting.

# ECCO chaired discussion session for ECRs – Date 2026-09-01

An opportunity for ECRs to discuss their experiences working in the field and provide feedback to the ECN in an anonymous and relaxed environment.

![](ecr-events-img/250813-105121.avif){fig-align="center"}

# ECR social/Pub quiz hosted at Tiny Rebel – Date 2026-09-03

A fun quiz (non-science-based) hosted by ECCO in a popular bar run by the Welsh craft brewery Tiny Rebel located in the centre of Cardiff (CF10 1DD). 
Limited spaces are available (60) so please indicate during registration that you wish to attend. 
Food, drinks and prizes will be included!

![](ecr-events-img/250813-105332.avif){fig-align="center"}

# 5th annual ECCO PhD journal article award and talk – Conference session

5th annual ECCO PhD Journal Article Award, sponsored by the European Complement Network (ECN), offering a prize of €500. 
Applications for this award will be opening soon, and the winner will be announced and be invited to deliver an oral presentation during the ECMHD meeting. 

If you need more information, queries or suggestions for additional activities/events, don't hesitate to email [emchd2026@cardiff.ac.uk](mailto:emchd2026@cardiff.ac.uk). 
We look forward to welcoming you to Cardiff for an engaging and productive EMCHD meeting.
